case.name: Siemens AG
case.constructed: The invoice converts EUR to USD with the rate inverted (USD per EUR used as EUR per USD), a common spreadsheet error.

expect.why: USD 8,620 is EUR 10,000 at the inverse of the EUR/USD rate, which is roughly a fifth short of the true amount, far outside a 2% tolerance.
